data.name: Check_TriggerTopic

data.value: Enter the topic to wait on.

data.name: Designer_Collapse
data.value: Collapse into its tabs; choose a tab to open it again

data.name: Designer_CouldNotSave
data.value: The workflow could not be saved: {0}

data.name: Designer_DeleteQuestion
data.value: Delete this workflow's file? Runs already made are kept.

data.name: Designer_FailOnErrorStatus
data.value: An answer that is not a success goes out by error

data.name: Designer_Float
data.value: Float in a window of its own; close the window to put it back

data.name: Designer_FolderNotEmpty
data.value: Only an empty folder can be deleted. Move its workflows out first.

data.name: Designer_GlobalRequiredTip
data.value: Refuse a run whose input leaves this empty

data.name: Designer_GlobalValueTip
data.value: Choose a path from the sample inputs, or type a value: JSON, text, or paths such as {{input.order.id}}

data.name: Designer_GlobalVariablesTip
data.value: Set when a run starts, before its first step, and read by every step as {{vars.name}}. A value is JSON or text, or taken from the input, such as {{input.order.id}}. A required one that comes out empty refuses the run.

data.name: Designer_InFolder
data.value: New workflows and folders go in {0}.

data.name: Designer_InTheTopFolder
data.value: New workflows and folders go at the top.

data.name: Designer_KeepTheResultIn
data.value: Keep the result in the variable

data.name: Designer_KindTip
data.value: Short workflows finish while you wait and are stopped at the time limit on Settings / Workflow Settings. Long workflows have no limit, are written down after every step, and carry on after Joktan starts again.

data.name: Designer_LinkLabelHint
data.value: Written on the link, such as Approved

data.name: Designer_MakeOrChooseAWorkflow
data.value: Make a workflow with New workflow, or choose one on the left.

data.name: Designer_MergeIntoIt
data.value: Merge the value, a JSON object, into what the variable holds

data.name: Designer_MqttInputTip
data.value: The message's payload is the run's input, so it must be JSON; the topic is {{run.topic}}. A message that is not JSON starts no run.

data.name: Designer_NoWorkflowsYet
data.value: No workflows yet. Press New workflow.

data.name: Designer_Output
data.value: Output: JSON, which may use paths

data.name: Designer_PaletteHint
data.value: Drag a step onto the canvas, or click it to add it after the step selected.

data.name: Designer_PathsTip
data.value: Later steps read it as {{vars.name}}, or {{last}} straight after. Go further in with dots and [index], as in {{vars.reply.body.items[0].id}}.

data.name: Designer_RetryTip
data.value: Each try shows on Workflows / Runs. A pause stops the wait, and a long workflow keeps waiting across a restart.

data.name: Designer_RunInputTip
data.value: The input Run starts the workflow with: a sample, or one typed in

data.name: Designer_RunTip
data.value: Run the workflow now with the input chosen beside it, and watch it on Workflows / Runs

data.name: Designer_SampleInputTip
data.value: Inputs, as JSON, to start a run by hand with: choose one beside Run, or on Workflows / Runs. Paths such as {{input.name}} read the input.

data.name: Designer_ScheduleNoMoreRuns
data.value: The schedule has no more runs.

data.name: Designer_ScheduleStartsWhenSaved
data.value: The schedule starts once the workflow is saved.

data.name: Designer_ScheduleTip
data.value: A run is started at each time, even while the one before is still going. Times that pass while Joktan is closed are skipped.

data.name: Designer_SchedulesOff
data.value: Schedules are switched off on Settings / Workflow Settings.

data.name: Designer_StartFromRest
data.value: Start from the REST API and the agent, with workflow_start

data.name: Designer_StartOnMqtt
data.value: Start when an MQTT message arrives

data.name: Designer_StartTip
data.value: Every run begins here. Its result is the run's input, so the next step can use {{last}} or {{input}}. What starts the workflow is set below.

data.name: Designer_TheSampleInputIsNotJson
data.value: The sample input is not JSON: {0}

data.name: Designer_TopicFilter
data.value: Topic, which may have + and # wildcards

data.name: Designer_TriesAgain
data.value: Times to try again before going out by error

data.name: Designer_TriggersTip
data.value: A workflow can always be run by hand. These let other things start it too.

data.name: Designer_Value
data.value: Value: JSON, which may use paths, or text

data.name: Designer_WaitTip
data.value: Off, this run carries on at once with the new run's id, and the two run side by side.

data.name: Designer_ZoomIn
data.value: Zoom in (or Ctrl and the wheel)

data.name: Designer_ZoomOut
data.value: Zoom out (or Ctrl and the wheel)

data.name: Runs_AnswerBy
data.value: Answer by {0}, or it goes on without

data.name: Runs_ChooseARun
data.value: Choose a run on the left.

data.name: Runs_DiagramKey
data.value: Green steps and links are those the run took, red is where it failed, and amber is where it is waiting. A number is how many times a step ran.

data.name: Runs_KillTip
data.value: Stop the run at once, and any workflow it is waiting on

data.name: Runs_NoRuns
data.value: No runs yet. Start one here, with Run on Workflows / Designer, from the REST API or with an MQTT message.

data.name: Settings_CSharpImports
data.value: Usings for every C# script, one per line

data.name: Settings_CSharpImportsTip
data.value: As if each script began with these using lines. System, files (System.IO), LINQ, collections, tasks, text, regular expressions, HTTP and System.Text.Json are always there.

data.name: Settings_CSharpLibraries
data.value: Libraries for every C# script, one per line

data.name: Settings_GlobalLibrariesTip
data.value: These come before the libraries a step lists, as if every step listed them too. A folder brings everything in it: its .dll files, its .js files in name order, or its Go modules, found by their go.mod. Go only allows imports a program uses, so a module here is there to import, not imported.

data.name: Settings_GoLibraries
data.value: Modules every Go program can import, one per line

data.name: Settings_GoNotFound
data.value: The go command was not found. Install Go, or enter where it is.

data.name: Settings_JavaScriptLibraries
data.value: Libraries for every JavaScript script, one per line

data.name: Settings_MaxRunningTip
data.value: More wait in the queue. Runs that are only waiting, for a delay, a message or an answer, do not count.

data.name: Settings_MaxSteps
data.value: Most steps one run may take

data.name: Settings_MaxStepsTip
data.value: A run that takes more fails, which stops a loop with no way out. A run that loops keeps only its latest 500 steps to look back on.

data.name: Settings_MqttTriggersTip
data.value: Off, the MQTT triggers of every workflow are ignored.

data.name: Settings_NuGetFeed
data.value: NuGet feeds for C# libraries, one per line

data.name: Settings_NuGetFeedTip
data.value: Feeds' package base addresses, such as nuget.org's, or folders of .nupkg files. A package's latest version is the highest any feed has; a version comes from the first feed that has it.

data.name: Settings_ResumeLongRuns
data.value: Carry on long workflows when Joktan starts

data.name: Settings_ResumeLongRunsTip
data.value: Off, they wait paused on Workflows / Runs until resumed.

data.name: Settings_ScheduleTriggersTip
data.value: Off, the schedules of every workflow are ignored.

data.name: Settings_ScriptsTip
data.value: C# and JavaScript run inside Joktan. Go is built and run with the go command, so Go must be installed.

data.name: Settings_ScriptTimeLimit
data.value: Time limit of a script, in seconds

data.name: Settings_ScriptTimeLimitTip
data.value: Building a Go program for the first time counts too.

data.name: Settings_ShortTimeLimit
data.value: Time limit of short workflows, in seconds

data.name: Settings_ShortTimeLimitTip
data.value: A short workflow still running then is stopped and fails. Long workflows have no limit.

data.name: Settings_WorkflowsFolderTip
data.value: Each workflow is a .workflow.json file in this folder, so they can be kept with a project and in version control.

data.name: Settings_WorkingFolderTip
data.value: Where scripts work, unless a step names its own. A Go program runs in it; C# has it as WorkingFolder and InFolder("file"), and JavaScript as workingFolder, with readText, writeText and fileExists for the files in it.

data.name: Step_AddFolderTip
data.value: Add a folder: all its .dll files for C#, its .js files for JavaScript, or its Go modules

data.name: Step_CaseExample
data.value: A value, such as paid or 200

data.name: Step_CSharpCondition
data.value: C# that gives true or false, such as (int)Vars["count"]! > 3

data.name: Step_CSharpLibrariesTip
data.value: NuGet packages, such as Newtonsoft.Json 13.0.3, or a name alone for the latest, with the packages they need; or .dll files. Add using lines at the top of the code.

data.name: Step_CSharpTip
data.value: Input, Vars, Last and Log("…") are at hand, with System.Text.Json.Nodes. What it returns is the step's result. It runs inside Joktan, so only run code you trust.

data.name: Step_GlobalImports
data.value: Every script also has, from Settings / Workflow Settings: {0}

data.name: Step_GoLibrariesTip
data.value: Modules, such as github.com/google/uuid@v1.6.0, or module => folder for one on this computer. Import them in the code as usual.

data.name: Step_GoTip
data.value: A Go program in package main. The run's input, vars and last come in on stdin as JSON; write the result to stdout as JSON. It is built with the go command on Settings / Workflow Settings.

data.name: Step_IndexVariable
data.value: The count, from 0, in the variable

data.name: Step_JavaScriptLibrariesTip
data.value: Script files, or their addresses, such as one on a CDN. They run before the code, in order, so what they define is at hand; an address is fetched once.

data.name: Step_JavaScriptTip
data.value: input, vars, last and log("…") are at hand. What it returns is the step's result, and what it changes in vars is kept. It runs inside Joktan, without the network, and with files only in its working folder.

data.name: Step_LoopTip
data.value: Link loop to the first step to repeat, and the last of them back here. A list goes item by item, an object entry by entry as {key, value}, and a number counts from 0.

data.name: Step_NoWorkingFolder
data.value: None; set one, or a default on Settings / Workflow Settings

data.name: Step_OnlyAMessageWhere
data.value: Only a message where, using {{message.payload}}; empty takes the first

data.name: Step_OpenInAWindowTip
data.value: Edit the code in a large editor window of its own

data.name: Step_SwitchTip
data.value: The value goes out by the first case equal to it, compared as a condition's equals, or by default. A case may be JSON or a path.

data.name: Step_TheCodeCompiles
data.value: The code has no mistakes that stop it running.

data.name: Step_TopicEmptyKeepsTheMessages
data.value: Topic; empty keeps the message's own

data.name: Step_TopicToWaitOn
data.value: Topic to wait on, which may have + and #

data.name: Step_WorkingFolderTip
data.value: A Go program runs in it. C# has it as WorkingFolder, with InFolder("data.csv") for a file in it; JavaScript as workingFolder, with readText, writeText and fileExists, which only reach files in it. It may use paths, such as {{vars.folder}}.

data.name: StepTip_CallWorkflow
data.value: Starts another workflow, and waits for its output or carries on at once.

data.name: StepTip_Condition
data.value: Goes out by true or false, on a comparison or on C#.

data.name: StepTip_Delay
data.value: Waits for a while. A pause stops the clock.

data.name: StepTip_End
data.value: Finishes the run, with an output for whoever started it or waits on it.

data.name: StepTip_Fail
data.value: Stops the run as failed, with a reason.

data.name: StepTip_ForEach
data.value: Goes out by loop once for each item of a list, each entry of an object, or a number of times, then by done. Link the end of the loop back to it.

data.name: StepTip_Grpc
data.value: Calls a gRPC method saved in the API Client, or one written here.

data.name: StepTip_Http
data.value: Sends a REST request saved in the API Client, with its body kept, replaced or merged into, or one written here.

data.name: StepTip_Log
data.value: Writes a line in the run's log.

data.name: StepTip_MqttPublish
data.value: Publishes a client's folder message, with its body kept, replaced or merged into, or one written here.

data.name: StepTip_MqttWait
data.value: Waits for a message on a topic, optionally one that passes a test.

data.name: StepTip_Script
data.value: Runs C# or JavaScript inside Joktan, or Go with the go command.

data.name: StepTip_SetVariable
data.value: Sets a variable to a value, or merges a JSON object into it.

data.name: StepTip_Start
data.value: Where every run begins. Its result is the run's input.

data.name: StepTip_Switch
data.value: Compares a value with its cases, and goes out by the first that is equal, or by default.

data.name: StepTip_UserInput
data.value: Asks a person for values on Workflows / Runs, or through the REST API, and waits for the answer.

data.name: StepTip_While
data.value: Goes out by loop for as long as a comparison holds, then by done. Link the end of the loop back to it.

data.name: Check_ChooseDatabase
data.value: Choose the database the step uses.

data.name: Check_ChooseTable
data.value: Choose the table the step works on.

data.name: Check_ColumnTwice
data.value: A column is given a value more than once.

data.name: Check_ColumnVariableName
data.value: A column's variable needs a name of letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit.

data.name: Check_FilterCannotBeCSharp
data.value: A filter cannot be C#; choose another comparison.

data.name: Check_InsertNeedsRows
data.value: Say which list the rows come from.

data.name: Check_UpdateNeedsColumns
data.value: Choose the columns to change, and their values.

data.name: Connection_EnterAHost
data.value: Enter the server's host name or address.

data.name: Connection_EnterUserAndDatabase
data.value: Enter the username and the database.

data.name: Connection_NoCredentialStore
data.value: The connection is saved, but this computer has no credential store to keep its password in.

data.name: Connection_PasswordKept
data.value: Leave empty to keep the password

data.name: Connection_PasswordNotKept
data.value: The connection is saved, but its password could not be kept in the credential store.

data.name: Connection_PortRange
data.value: The port must be from 1 to 65535.

data.name: DatabaseStep_AllRowsTip
data.value: On: the variable gets a list, of this column's value in every row. Off: a single value, the first row's.

data.name: DatabaseStep_ChangeResultTip
data.value: The result is the rows as they are now, with their numbered ids and defaults, such as [{"id": 7, "name": "tea"}].

data.name: DatabaseStep_ConfigureTip
data.value: Choose the database, table and columns in a window of their own

data.name: DatabaseStep_CouldNotRead
data.value: The database could not be read: {0}

data.name: DatabaseStep_EachRowIn
data.value: Each item is in the variable

data.name: DatabaseStep_FiltersTip
data.value: Only rows that pass every filter are read or updated. Values may use paths, such as {{vars.orderId}}.

data.name: DatabaseStep_FirstRowOnly
data.value: Only the first row, rather than a list

data.name: DatabaseStep_InsertColumnsTip
data.value: Tick the columns to give values to; the others get their defaults. A value may be text, JSON or a path, such as {{vars.name}}. Any column's value can also go in a variable, such as the id the new row was given.

data.name: DatabaseStep_ManyRows
data.value: A row for each item of a list

data.name: DatabaseStep_ManyRowsTip
data.value: Each column's value is worked out once for each item, which is in {{{{vars.{0}}}}} while it is, such as {{{{vars.{0}.name}}}}. All the rows are inserted together, or none are.

data.name: DatabaseStep_NoColumnsYet
data.value: Choose a database and a table, and its columns are shown here.

data.name: DatabaseStep_NoDatabases
data.value: There are no databases yet. Make one on Data / Database, or add a connection to one.

data.name: DatabaseStep_PutInVariable
data.value: Put its value in the variable

data.name: DatabaseStep_ReadColumnsTip
data.value: Tick the columns to read; with none ticked, all are read. A column's value can also go in a variable, the first row's or a list of every row's.

data.name: DatabaseStep_ReadResultTip
data.value: The result is the rows read, a list of objects, such as [{"id": 1, "name": "tea"}].

data.name: DatabaseStep_RefreshTip
data.value: Read the schemas, tables and columns again

data.name: DatabaseStep_Subtitle
data.value: Choose the table, the columns and the filters. Changes are saved as you make them.

data.name: DatabaseStep_UpdateColumnsTip
data.value: Tick the columns to change in the rows that pass the filters. A value may be text, JSON or a path; empty is NULL. Any column's new value can also go in a variable.

data.name: Settings_DatabaseConnectionsTip
data.value: PostgreSQL databases that database steps can use, besides those on Data / Database. Passwords are kept in the credential store.

data.name: Settings_NoConnections
data.value: No connections yet. The databases on Data / Database can be used without one.

data.name: Check_FilterNeedsComparison
data.value: At least one filter must compare a column with a value, so that not every row is changed or deleted.

data.name: Check_FilterNeedsValue
data.value: Every filter needs a value, so that a missing one can never choose every row.

data.name: Check_KeyNeedsValue
data.value: Give each key column a value.

data.name: Check_NeedsFilter
data.value: Add a filter that says which rows; every row is never changed or deleted.

data.name: Check_UpsertNeedsKey
data.value: Choose the key columns that say which row is the one to update.

data.name: DatabaseStep_DeleteResultTip
data.value: The result is the rows deleted, as they were, such as [{"id": 7, "name": "tea"}].

data.name: DatabaseStep_FiltersRequiredTip
data.value: Needed: only rows that pass every filter are {0}, and never every row. Each filter needs a value, such as {{{{vars.orderId}}}}; if one comes out empty when the workflow runs, the step fails and nothing is {0}.

data.name: DatabaseStep_KeyNeedsValue
data.value: Needs a value: it finds the row

data.name: DatabaseStep_MatchTip
data.value: A row with the same values in the key columns is updated; otherwise a new row is inserted. The key columns must be the primary key or have a unique index.

data.name: DatabaseStep_NoFilters
data.value: none yet — it will not run without one

data.name: DatabaseStep_PutChangedInVariable
data.value: Put its new value in the variable

data.name: DatabaseStep_UpsertColumnsTip
data.value: Tick the columns to give values to, and switch on Key for those that find the row. A value may be text, JSON or a path. Any column's value can also go in a variable, such as the id of the row.

data.name: StepTip_DatabaseDelete
data.value: Deletes the rows of a table that pass its filters. It never runs without a filter.

data.name: StepTip_DatabaseInsert
data.value: Inserts a row into a table of a PostgreSQL database, or one for each item of a list.

data.name: StepTip_DatabaseRead
data.value: Reads rows of a table of a PostgreSQL database into variables: single values or lists.

data.name: StepTip_DatabaseUpdate
data.value: Changes the rows of a table that pass its filters. It never runs without a filter.

data.name: StepTip_DatabaseUpsert
data.value: Updates the row whose key columns match, or inserts it when there is none.

data.name: Designer_ResultVariableTip
data.value: Choose a global variable or one another step keeps its result in, or type a new name.

data.name: Check_MetadataNeedsName
data.value: Give each metadata value a name.

data.name: Check_MetadataReserved
data.value: runId, serial and assignedTo always go with the question; give the metadata another name.

data.name: Check_MetadataTwice
data.value: Two metadata values have the same name.

data.name: Designer_MetadataTip
data.value: Goes with the question, for whoever answers it: constants, or global variables such as {{vars.customer}}. The run's id (runId) and serial number (serial) are always included.

data.name: Check_AssignTheQuestion
data.value: Assign the question to a role, or to a user.

data.name: Check_EscalateAfter
data.value: Say how long to wait before escalating, such as 30m or 4h.

data.name: Check_EscalateToWhom
data.value: Choose the role, or the user, the question is escalated to.

data.name: Check_AssignedToAUser
data.value: The question is assigned to one user, which is bad practice: when they are away or leave, nobody else can answer it. Assign it to a role instead.

data.name: Check_EscalatedToAUser
data.value: The question is escalated to one user, which is bad practice: when they are away or leave, nobody else can answer it. Escalate it to a role instead.

data.name: Check_EscalatesTooLate
data.value: The question would be escalated after its time limit has run out, so it never is. Escalate it sooner, or give it longer.

data.name: Designer_AssignedToTip
data.value: Who answers the question. Assign it to a role, so that anyone with the role can answer; roles and users are on the Users page.

data.name: Designer_NoRoles
data.value: There are no roles to choose from yet. Create the users database on the Users page.

data.name: Designer_Escalate
data.value: Escalate when it is not answered in time

data.name: Designer_EscalateTip
data.value: The question goes to someone else after a while, and carries on waiting for an answer.

data.name: Runs_EscalatesAt
data.value: Escalated to {0} at {1} if not answered

data.name: Designer_PageTip
data.value: Optional. The page of Workflows / Pages the person fills in on the website. Without one, the website shows the question and a box for each field. A page's fields are added to those below.

data.name: Designer_NoPage
data.value: No page: the question and its fields

data.name: Pages_Subtitle
data.value: Build the pages that user input steps show on the website

data.name: Pages_NoPages
data.value: No pages yet. Click New page to make one.

data.name: Pages_WebsiteOff
data.value: Switch on the website on Settings / Website to preview the page in a browser.

data.name: Pages_DeleteQuestion
data.value: Delete this page? User input steps that show it will fail until they are given another.

data.name: Pages_CouldNotDelete
data.value: The page could not be deleted: {0}

data.name: Pages_CouldNotSave
data.value: The page could not be saved: {0}

data.name: Pages_AddTip
data.value: Click to add under the item selected.

data.name: Pages_ChooseOrMake
data.value: Choose a page on the left, or make a new one.

data.name: Pages_TitleFromQuestion
data.value: No title: the website shows the step's question.

data.name: Pages_PathsTip
data.value: Text may use paths into the run, such as {{input.orderId}} or {{vars.customer.name}}; they are filled in when the step asks.

data.name: Pages_FieldNameTip
data.value: The name the answer gives the value, as in {{vars.answer.approved}}.

data.name: Pages_OptionsTip
data.value: One to a line. A line that is only a path to a list, such as {{vars.colours}}, gives each item of the list.

data.name: Pages_DefaultHint
data.value: Empty, a value, or a path; true ticks a check box

data.name: Pages_RequiredTip
data.value: The page cannot be sent without it; a required check box must be ticked.

data.name: Pages_FieldNameNotValid
data.value: "{0}" cannot be a field name: use letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.

data.name: Step_TrueLabelExample
data.value: such as Approved; blank shows true

data.name: Step_FalseLabelExample
data.value: such as Rejected; blank shows false

data.name: Step_DefaultLabelExample
data.value: such as Anything else; blank shows default

data.name: Designer_LanesTip
data.value: Optional. Bands across the canvas, such as one for each team or role. A step is in the lane it sits in; drag a step to move it to another lane, and a lane's bottom edge to make it taller or shorter.

data.name: Designer_LaneHeight
data.value: Height; the lanes under it, and their steps, move with it

data.name: Designer_CreatePageTip
data.value: Makes a page on Workflows / Pages with the question as its title and a box for each field below (or a box to tick and a comment when there are none), and chooses it. Change it there.
